title: In-game sounds
author: lnkkonito
selftext: Hey! I wonder what's best option for generating game sound design like animation, collision, destruction ? Thanks!

comments.author: redline_hockey
comments.body: there are lot of websites that offer real royalty free sound effects. quick google search for that. for ai-generated probably best to use 11 labs. they can produce some pretty realistic things and have a massive library and you can get a pro account for like 1$ for a month. sound is so important and imo what really separates something from being ai slop clone vs more premium project.

replies.author: redline_hockey
replies.body: for my hockey game I'm building I wasn't happy of the sounds effects anywhere so I just went to my local ice rink and recorded sounds with my phone. took time and effort but now when I play game it def feels like it has more human touch then a lot of the ai games I see

comments.author: TypicalPack9024
comments.body: Using website or any ui will make you slow. I did it with claude and elevenlabs mcp. Asked claude to generate sound browser app, then ask claude to generated few variants for each sound with elevenlabs. Next pick sounds you like from the generated browser app, if not then input reason why you don't like it and regenerate it, repeat until you are satisfied.

replies.author: Icy-Fact8432
replies.body: I used elevenlabs manually but this approach sounds better!

replies.author: NIGHTrock16
replies.body: That's exactly what I did lol

replies.author: MrShaitan
replies.body: I did this too, elevenlabs is amazing. I’ve added music and speech recognition and text to speech to my app through it as well. I also use it to create images through Chat GPT

comments.author: Relative_Maize_6411
comments.body: I told claude AI to make a local sound and music generator application that works out good I think with local models from huggingface this way I don´t have to use any paid online sound generator.

comments.author: KMReiserFS
comments.body: https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/ is great for free audio, also i used Antigravity CLI free tier for some specify sfx that i do not found for free.

comments.author: No-Gap-2380
comments.body: My favorite source is [opengameart.org](http://opengameart.org) but be very careful to respect the licenses. If you abuse these assets, artists like myself will stop sharing them, if nothing else. Very many are CC0 though.

comments.author: Ukawok92
comments.body:
You're better off using royalty free SFX rather than generating your own. Here is a good resource. 

https://sonniss.com/gameaudiogdc/

I used some from here in my game

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.puzzlerush.game&pcampaignid=web_share
